summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that the Toronto Stock Exchange lifted its remedial delisting review, so its common shares will continue trading on TSX. The filing is a routine update confirming no delisting occurs. No deal terms, prices, or premiums are stated. The company noted the decision follows a binding term sheet for restructuring its commercial bank debt. As a foreign private issuer, Largo mapped the TSX decision to a US delisting context, but the event is not a special situation requiring category classification; rather, it is a status update. What to watch is continued regulatory compliance and the bank debt restructuring progress.
